title: A Kind Christmas
setting: A snowy town street at Christmas time.

characters.name: Aiko
characters.look: Aiko, a kind Japanese woman with short black hair and a blue sweater

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: Dan, a tall man with glasses and a brown coat

characters.name: Finn
characters.look: Finn, a small boy with curly hair and a red hat

sentences.en: Aiko was born in a small Japanese town.
sentences.zh: 爱子出生在日本的一个小镇。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a kind Japanese woman with short black hair and a blue sweater as a baby in her mother's arms in front of a small Japanese house.

sentences.en: Dan is her husband, and Finn is their child.
sentences.zh: 丹是她的丈夫，芬恩是他们的孩子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a kind Japanese woman with short black hair and a blue sweater, Dan, a tall man with glasses and a brown coat and Finn, a small boy with curly hair and a red hat stand together as a happy family in their living room.

sentences.en: At Christmas, they bring warm clothes for poor children.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节时，他们给贫穷的孩子们送去暖和的衣服。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a kind Japanese woman with short black hair and a blue sweater, Dan, a tall man with glasses and a brown coat and Finn, a small boy with curly hair and a red hat carry boxes of coats and scarves through a snowy street with Christmas lights.

sentences.en: A friendly policeman shows them the way.
sentences.zh: 一位友好的警察给他们指路。
sentences.scene_prompt: A smiling policeman points down a snowy street for Aiko, a kind Japanese woman with short black hair and a blue sweater, Dan, a tall man with glasses and a brown coat and Finn, a small boy with curly hair and a red hat.

sentences.en: A little girl in the snow has no coat.
sentences.zh: 雪地里一个小女孩没有外套。
sentences.scene_prompt: A little girl in a thin dress stands shivering in the snow.

sentences.en: Dan's wife lets Finn give her a coat.
sentences.zh: 丹的妻子让芬恩把一件外套送给她。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a kind Japanese woman with short black hair and a blue sweater nods as Finn, a small boy with curly hair and a red hat hands a warm coat to a little girl in the snow.

sentences.en: The girl smiles and says, "You are so kind!"
sentences.scene_prompt: A little girl in a new warm coat smiles at Finn, a small boy with curly hair and a red hat, Aiko, a kind Japanese woman with short black hair and a blue sweater and Dan, a tall man with glasses and a brown coat.

sentences.en: For Finn, this is a true Christmas.
sentences.zh: 对芬恩来说，这才是真正的圣诞节。
sentences.scene_prompt: Finn, a small boy with curly hair and a red hat beams with joy under falling snow next to Aiko, a kind Japanese woman with short black hair and a blue sweater and Dan, a tall man with glasses and a brown coat.
